- [ASSISTANT_SAID] For Senior Consultant: Technical skills include a deep understanding of relevant technologies and tools, providing technical leadership and guidance to others on the team.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] For Senior Consultant: Self-Starter demonstrates mastery of the ability to work independently and take ownership of their work, proactively identifying opportunities for improvement.
